description: This file contains error handling code, constants, and functions for mapping database error codes to internal error representations within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer.

methods.name: adodb_errormsg
methods.description: Returns a localized error message based on the error code or key.

methods.name: adodb_error
methods.description: Maps database provider-specific error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_pg
methods.description: Maps PostgreSQL error messages or codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_odbc
methods.description: Provides a mapping of ODBC error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_ibase
methods.description: Maps InterBase error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_ifx
methods.description: Maps Informix error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_oci8
methods.description: Maps Oracle OCI8 error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_mssql
methods.description: Maps MS SQL Server error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_sqlite
methods.description: Maps SQLite error codes to internal error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_mysql
methods.description: Maps MySQL error codes to internal error constants.
